entities.title: root
entities.summary: A named directory inside a git work tree that a session asks about; tool paths are written root:relative/path.
notToBeConfusedWith: The repository's top level: a root may be any directory inside the work tree.
MCP roots, which zazzle-csharp-indexer does not use.

entities.title: blob
entities.summary: One distinct file content, identified by its git blob id; its analysis is stored once and shared by every file with that content.
notToBeConfusedWith: The integer blob id in store.db, which is the row id the file records point at.

entities.title: stat key
entities.summary: A file's size, modification time and birth time, stored with its record; while it is unchanged the file is not read again.

entities.title: reconcile
entities.summary: A full pass over a root: list git's files, analyse new or changed ones, drop vanished ones.
notToBeConfusedWith: barrier, which re-checks only the files a query needs

entities.title: barrier
entities.summary: Applying queued change events and re-checking the stat key of every file a query will use, just before it answers.

entities.title: cursor
entities.summary: The value changed_since returns: the engine's epoch followed by each root's generation, valid only within the engine run that issued it.

entities.title: parsed / heuristic
entities.summary: The label on symbol answers: parsed when they come from a Roslyn syntax tree (C#), heuristic when they come from line regexes or word matches.

entities.title: path and reason (usage log)
entities.summary: How an answer was produced (index, scan, fallback:<engine>, run:<program>, view, hook) and why, recorded for every call.
notToBeConfusedWith: A file path: the usage log's path field is a resolution path.

entities.title: state directory
entities.summary: The per-user directory holding store.db, the usage log, the daemon socket and config.json.
